patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: After a greasy dinner I got this deep pain under my right ribs that won't let up — it wraps around to my shoulder blade. Makes me nauseous, and it hurts more when I breathe in deep.
clinical.presentationShort: 44yo F ? persistent RUQ pain after fatty meal, radiating to right shoulder blade, nausea, fever, and marked tenderness with deep inspiration.
clinical.presentationLong: 44-year-old female with persistent pain beneath the right ribs after a fatty meal, radiating to the right shoulder blade. She is nauseated and febrile, with marked right-upper-quadrant tenderness that catches her breath on deep palpation.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → RUQ ultrasound, labs, analgesia, antibiotics, surgery consult; likely cholecystectomy.
diagnosis.why: Fatty meal + RUQ pain to the scapula + Murphy's + fever = cholecystitis. Ultrasound first; surgery follows.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, hand pressed under her right ribs, guarded
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 44-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one hand pressed under her right ribs, guarding. Expression: grimacing and nauseated. Clearly visible: a hand pressed under the right rib cage. No text, no logos.
